title: Item 14 of Part II A of Schedule 14 of GN 153/2004 - Fully processed forest products fees not possessing harvesting license or receipts from registered dealer, as substituted by GN 195/2017
text:
**ITEM 14: Fully processed forest products fees not possessing harvesting license or receipts from registered dealer shall be**

|   | **Forest product** | **Fees in Tshs.**  |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  (a) | Mpingo carvings per kg | 4,600  |
|  (b) | Other carvings per kg | 3,000  |
|  (c) | Door shutters per piece | 50,500  |
|  (d) | Door and window frames per piece | 51,800  |
|  (e) | Cup boards per piece | 50,000  |
|  (f) | Chair and stool per piece | 17,250  |
|  (g) | Wooden school desks per piece | 17,250  |
|  (h) | Bed per piece | 20,000  |
|  (i) | Wooden office table per piece | 25,000  |
|  (j) | 1 set of wooden coach per set of 3 to 6 pieces | 30,000  |
|   | Any additional piece | 20,000  |
|  (k) | Basket/Mats per kg | 1,700  |
|  (j) | Other wooden small items per piece | 1,700  |

*NB: Used wooden furniture shall not be charged*
note: As-printed text. Source: the official Gazette publication document of GN No. 195 of 5/5/2017, uploaded by the maintainer (file name follows the TanzLII publication-document naming). This transcript was OCR-extracted because the extraction environment could not read the text layer; instances where it deviates from the printed text are to be restored after the maintainer's comparison. The substitution in regulation 2 of GN 195/2017 replaces Item 14 of Part II A of the Fourteenth Schedule to the Forest Regulations, 2004 (GN No. 153 of 2004). GN 255 of 2017 later replaced the whole Fourteenth Schedule; this provision records the historical text as substituted by GN 195 and is not the currently applicable fee schedule.
